title: A matched long path contributes to the sum
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\mathbb F_2^n$ be the set of length-$n$ vectors over the two-element field, and let a path specify branch values at some coordinates and an output label. For a finite list of such paths, a natural number $k$, and a vector $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$, if a path in the list has more than $k$ specified coordinates and its specified values agree with $x$, then the sum over the list of the indicators of the paths with more than $k$ specified coordinates is at least $1$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: The specified path belongs to the list
